title: Shopify → Sheets → AI → Alerts
summary: Every new Shopify order is logged to Google Sheets, classified by AI for risk, priority and customer type, and flagged in Slack or by email when it needs a person.
result: Each order is logged and classified within about a minute; risky, rush and VIP orders reach the team before they ship.

metric.label: of manual order review saved per week

note: Demo built with simulated Shopify test orders sent to an n8n webhook. Time saved is estimated for a store with about 40 orders a day.

flow.label: New order sent to a webhook

Orders sheet with the AI's risk, priority, customer type and reason for every order

upworkBlurb: n8n automation for a Shopify store: every new order hits a webhook, gets logged to Google Sheets and is classified by AI (Claude API) for fraud risk, shipping priority and customer type, with a one-line reason. Risky, rush and VIP orders trigger a Slack message and an email so the team acts before shipping. Saves about 5 hours a week of manual order checks (estimate). Demo uses simulated test orders; the importable n8n workflow JSON is included. Stack: n8n, Shopify, Google Sheets, Claude API, Slack, Gmail.

pt.title: Shopify → Planilha → IA → Alertas

pt.result: Cada pedido é registrado e classificado em cerca de um minuto; pedidos de risco, urgentes e de clientes VIP chegam à equipe antes do envio.
pt.metricLabel: de conferência manual de pedidos economizadas por semana
pt.note: Demonstração feita com pedidos de teste simulados da Shopify enviados a um webhook do n8n. O tempo economizado é uma estimativa para uma loja com cerca de 40 pedidos por dia.
